name: crash_exit_dual
headline: crash_exit_dual: GATE FAILURE on G3 (dev_1990 maxDD -52.76% vs -30% bar) and G4 (1950-69, 1970-89, 2000-2012H1 eras all breach -40% DD); G1/G2/G5/G6/G7 pass (Sharpe 0.4494 clears the 0.425 bar). Genuine crash-trigger exit works on discrete shocks (1987 -8.8% vs SPY -25.0%; GFC exit fired 15-Sep-2008, out through the Oct capitulation) but a default-IN state machine rides grinding bears (2000-02 -54.2%, worse than SPY's -47.2%) at the 1x tier floor because no single day or VIX jump ever crosses the trigger while vol stays chronically elevated. Frozen point stands as a documented gate failure; never run through evaluate.py.
biggest_weakness: The 'am I in the market' state machine defaults to IN and exits only on a genuine sigma-normalised or VIX-jump shock, so it cannot see a grinding bear that never produces one: 2000-02 was ridden mostly at 1x the whole way (-54.2%, worse than buy-and-hold's -47.2%) and the Jan-Mar-2009 second GFC leg (-25% while still IN at 1x) because -4.3/-4.5% days were only -1.8..-2.1 sigma on an already-elevated ~2.3% sigma and VIX at 45-52 never jumped 30% above its own 10-day mean. A 1,272-combo grid search across four grid files never found a point that fixes the drawdown without giving up the Sharpe edge (the drawdown surface is flat at -50...-57% across the whole feasible region), and the one DD-constrained variant tested (j=0.10) drops Sharpe to 0.34 (below SPY) while still failing G4 on 1970-89.
note: Gate-failing candidate per PREREG.md Deviations #1 -- frozen point documented, not re-tuned by the finisher. See dev_results/volmanaged_RETURN.json for the schema-conforming StructuredOutput return of this task's other candidate (volmanaged, all gates pass).
